name: Alex Rivera
quote: Seeing the exact missing skills before sending out my applications was an eye-opener. Turning generic tasks into quantified achievement bullets took my match score from 58% to 92%—and I finally started getting direct recruiter responses.

name: Priya Menon
quote: Most resume builders just rearrange your layout. JobFit actually analyzes the target job description line-by-line and shows you keyword deficits in tools and SQL frameworks. Super fast and remarkably thorough.

name: David Keller
quote: The Google X-Y-Z bullet rewrites made a massive difference in how my project impact reads to hiring managers. The clean single-column PDF also exports without any weird parsing artifacts.
